summary: Iteration 3 bug-fix verification + regression. VERIFIED: generate_markdown in /app/backend/server.py now maps LLM quota/budget errors to HTTP 402 with the exact Indonesian message 'Saldo AI (Universal Key) habis. Buka Profile → Manage plan → Universal Key → Add Balance untuk menambah saldo, lalu coba lagi.' All 4 AI generators (POST /api/generate/modul-ajar, /soal, /rubrik, /kktp) correctly return 402 with this exact detail — the old generic 503 'Layanan AI sedang sibuk' path is no longer taken for budget-exhausted responses. NO REGRESSION on any non-AI endpoint: 34/34 non-AI tests pass (health GET /api/, profile GET/PUT + logo POST/GET/DELETE + 5MB reject + has_logo flag, classes CRUD incl. edit-siswa PUT replace, attendance POST with K3 warnings, list_attendance, recap math + zero-session, recap xlsx export, archives list/get/soft-delete + malformed-ID 400s, journals CRUD + tanggal-desc sort + soft-delete). Added new /app/backend/tests/test_pjok_iter3_quota.py with 5 tests (4 per-endpoint + 1 guardrail) — all 5 pass. The 5 failing tests in the full run (TestGenerateModulAjar/Soal/Rubrik/KKTP in test_pjok_backend.py + TestLogoEmbeddedExport in test_pjok_iter2.py) are legacy iter1/iter2 happy-path tests that assert 200 from live LLM; they now receive 402 because the key budget is still exhausted — this is the EXPECTED behavior under the new error-mapping fix and is a billing/key issue (NOT a code bug) per the review request's explicit instruction. Overall: 39/44 passed (5 failures all explainable by exhausted EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget, same root cause as iter2). Curl re-verification: `POST /api/generate/rubrik` → HTTP 402 with the exact Indonesian saldo-habis body (confirmed byte-for-byte).

minor.issue: Legacy iter1/iter2 generator tests (test_pjok_backend.py::TestGenerate* and test_pjok_iter2.py::TestLogoEmbeddedExport) hardcode `assert status_code == 200` and now fail with 402 because the key budget is exhausted. These are not code regressions, but main agent may want to mark them with pytest.mark.skipif / xfail('ai-budget-dependent') so a clean green run is possible without a funded key.

critical_code_review_comments: generate_markdown in server.py:175-195 now cleanly branches on exception message substrings: ('budget','quota','insufficient','exceeded','credit','payment','402') → HTTPException(402, saldo-habis-id); ('rate limit','429','too many') → HTTPException(429, …); fallthrough → HTTPException(503, …). Case-insensitive via .lower(). Correct ordering (quota checked before rate-limit, avoiding mis-mapping of 'exceeded' phrases). Message matches the review-request contract byte-for-byte.

Semaphore(_llm_lock=1) around chat.send_message prevents concurrent LLM calls on the single-concurrency key — exception is raised INSIDE the lock, so FastAPI's exception handler releases the lock on `async with` exit (correct).
No new changes elsewhere; _serialize still strips _id; soft-delete pattern uniform; CORS/startup/shutdown unchanged.

success_rate.backend: 89% (39/44).
